description: Devices have heterogeneous capacities (mean 1). Work items equal-sized.

methods.capacity_weighted: assign next item to lowest load/capacity

interpretation: On non-uniform device capacities, capacity-weighted assignment dominates. Golden-angle modular assignment does not improve on round-robin and is far from the capacity-aware optimum. The phyllotaxis packing advantage does not transfer to this discrete heterogeneous-capacity assignment.
